At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? The Logistics Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring inventory and shipments move accurately and on time across the business. This is a hands-on role responsible for the day-to-day execution of inventory management, allocation, and shipment planning.

Working closely with supply, warehouse, and transport teams, you’ll help ensure smooth operations and reliable delivery. You’ll also contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Inventory Management & Stock Allocation: Manage stock levels and order allocation to support planned dispatches and internal demand. Maintain accurate inventory records, including receipting, stock movements, and reconciliations. Work with the supply team to align inbound stock and identify excess or slow-moving inventory.
Shipment Planning & Execution: Book, coordinate, and track shipments to meet delivery schedules and customer commitments. Partner with warehouse, dispatch, and transport teams to ensure accurate, on-time fulfillment. Communicate shipment timelines and proactively resolve logistical issues.
Operational Improvement & General Activities: Identify and implement improvements across inventory, allocation, and dispatch processes. Use logistics systems to improve operational efficiency and reporting accuracy. Support the supply chain team with ad hoc operational tasks and ensure compliance with health and safety standards.

Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual USD$750 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.
Health Benefits - We offer best-in-class insurance for our employees, so they can care for themselves and their families.
16 weeks of paid parental leave for primary and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers plus many other parental benefits that support you and your family.
Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.
We're proud to offer 401k and make an employer match. We offer a 100% match on the first 3% you contribute, and a 50% match on the next 2%.
Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.
Our Office First Approach
There’s a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don’t do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world-class, in-person office culture is the best way for high-performing teams.
Being office first is a core pillar of our culture. We believe in-person connections are key to driving your own growth, learning, impact, and building genuine long-lasting relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful and aligned work. We don’t like having heaps of rules or policies, but this means having strong, trusted relationships is critical.
We’re office first , not office only . This means working from the office everyday is our default setting, but we flex when we need to. We have a high-trust culture, so everyone is trusted to do what’s best for Halter.
Our office vibe is something special, it’s hard to describe until you’re here, but people at Halter who have come from fully remote or hybrid companies say they could never go back - the high energy and spectacular people they are now surrounded by everyday makes work so enjoyable. Your growth, your learning and your impact is truly unlimited here, and a big part of that comes from being together solving problems, innovating, building context, and constantly learning from each other.
Join our team
Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement.

If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!
If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!
Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

s.h: Why our team loves working at Halter
s.t:
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. As a Shipping Specialist, you will be responsible for the expedient movement of designated items needed to support production, test, and launch operations. As a Shipping Specialist, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient and timely delivery of our products to internal and external customers.

Your primary responsibilities will include preparing and processing shipments, coordinating logistics, packaging, exception management, risk mitigation and maintaining and complying with global trade regulations.

Process outbound material through ERP system, partnering with appropriate departments to ensure quality and quantity of material is delivered to vendors, staged for shipping and or transferred between SpaceX locations
Properly package and manifest parcel, LTL, and large freight as required to ensure product integrity throughout the transportation cycle to intended destination
Manifest consignments with information provided by requestor and schedule movements accordingly based on delivery demand (FedEx, UPS, DHL, 3PL vendors, expedite courier services, etc.), ensuring that each package has the correct information and configuration to guarantee intended delivery conditions
Coordinate with carriers and freight forwarders to schedule pick-up and delivery of shipments
Prepare shipping labels, packing slips, and other necessary documents for each shipment
Verify the accuracy of shipping information, including addresses, product quantities, and delivery instructions
Inspect and package products for shipment, ensuring proper packaging and labeling
Determine the most cost-effective and efficient shipping methods for each order
Track and monitor shipments to ensure on-time delivery and resolve any issues or delays and accurately update required tracking systems (spreadsheets, modules, external data sources)

As the Manager of Logistics, you will own the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of inbound logistics, fulfillment networks, and global transportation operations.

You will drive carrier performance, develop and refine KPI methodologies, lead sourcing strategy and carrier partnerships, and expand logistics and transport networks that support freight, e-commerce, and industrial projects.

This role has end-to-end accountability for network health, cost optimization, and operational excellence across domestic and international movements.

Develop, execute, and continuously evolve enterprise-wide logistics strategies, programs, and initiatives that optimize inbound logistics, fulfillment networks, and end-to-end transportation performance, directly enabling the achievement of aggressive volume, cost, and profitability targets while supporting rapid business growth.
Establish and manage robust carrier performance management frameworks, including the design and maintenance of comprehensive KPIs, scorecards, and real-time reporting tools; leverage data analytics to identify trends, drive measurable operational improvements, and ensure the overall health and resilience of the global logistics network.
Lead strategic sourcing initiatives and cultivate high-performing carrier partnerships through end-to-end management of RFPs, contract negotiations, rate and tariff optimization, and ongoing performance governance with third-party logistics providers and transportation partners.
Drive the global expansion and optimization of logistics and transportation networks to support freight, e-commerce, and complex industrial project requirements, proactively identifying and onboarding new lanes, transportation modes, and service providers as business needs evolve.
Analyze, model, and redesign inbound and outbound transportation, distribution methods, and network architecture to deliver cost-effective, scalable, and operationally efficient solutions that reduce lead times and improve service levels.
Define, implement, and evolve a comprehensive set of Key Logistics Performance Indicators (KPIs) and executive-level dashboards that provide real-time visibility into network health, carrier performance, fulfillment operations, and overall supply chain effectiveness.
Identify, prioritize, and lead cross-functional cost-reduction and process-optimization initiatives across internal and external logistics spend, including packaging design, routing optimization, mode selection, and end-to-end process improvements.
Partner closely with Supply Chain, Production, and Engineering teams to align logistics strategies with broader business objectives and ensure seamless support for new product introductions, production ramps, and project launches.
Collaborate with Global Compliance, Customs, Tax, Finance, and Supply Chain stakeholders to ensure full adherence to all regulatory, customs, brokerage, duty, Incoterms, and trade compliance requirements while proactively identifying opportunities to reduce landed costs and streamline processes.
Develop, document, and institutionalize best practices for internal logistics operations, product flow optimization, packaging specifications, and material handling systems to drive consistency, safety, and efficiency across the organization.
Prepare, manage, and own the annual logistics budget for all inbound and outbound transportation spend, including forecasting, variance analysis, and strategic recommendations to optimize resource allocation.
Serve as the primary escalation point for complex logistics issues, leading root-cause analysis, implementing corrective and preventive actions, and driving accountability with both carriers and internal stakeholders to minimize disruption and improve long-term performance.

Job Title
Logistics Specialist
Job Description
Philips is a global leader in health technology, committed to improving billions of lives worldwide and striving to make the world healthier and more sustainable through innovation. Driven by the vision of a better tomorrow.
But it’s not just what we do, it’s who we are. We are 80,000, wonderfully unique individuals, with two things in common. An unwavering sense of purpose and a relentless determination to deliver on our customers’ needs. It’s what inspires us to create meaningful solutions – the kind that make a real difference – when it matters most.
The world and our customers’ needs are changing faster than ever before and while we are proud of what we do already, we know we can do more. That’s why we need you, to help us tackle increasingly complex challenges posed by ever evolving health and well-being needs.

In this role, you have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by improving operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. You will be responsible for providing operational, logistical, and warehousing support at the district level, with a strong focus on inventory control, customs clearance, shipment management (inbound/outbound), export compliance, and ensuring on-time delivery to customers.

Logistics, Compliance and Cost Control
Manage 3PL performance for warehouse and transportation providers, including KPI tracking, regular performance reviews, PO management and invoice review.
Actively collaborates with stakeholders and manages the supporting requirement for order-to-cash process (e.g. timely POD collection, close monitoring of backorders, managing tools/wheels requirements, etc).
Act as the point of contact regarding demo equipment movement and request and oversee the end-to-end process for demo / loan process.
Own warehouse, logistics, and export control compliance for the district including acting as the District Export Control Officer (ECO).
Manage both bonded and non-bonded inbound and outbound shipments, ensuring on-time and in-full delivery to customers/sites.
Manage order management with IWD teams, PCT and GBS OM, including documentation, shipment status, and backorder monitoring, to ensure on-time delivery through TMS optimization.
Oversee all Last Mile Provider (LMP) activities and maintain valid SLAs in collaboration with Procurement.
Act as Ship Hold Coordinator within the district and supervise end-to-end DEFOA and ensure timely completion.
Manage physical stock write-off and scrapping processes in collaboration with appointed external parties.
Partner with Quality & Regulatory teams on labeling activities and permit applications (BAPETEN, etc).
Support Sales teams with IWD cost inputs for customer quotations and ensure accurate cost (IWD / TPW) allocation to projects or business cost centers, including monthly incurred cost tracking and annual AOP budget proposal.
Submit internal control self-assessments on supply chain security, inventory and accrual inputs.
Provide logistics supporting documentation for financial related activities.
Own audit-related activities for warehouse and logistics with quality and HSE (e.g., GDPMD) and support customs audits when required.
Inventory Accuracy & Warehouse Management
Ensure posting accuracy across GR, GI, inbound, pick & pack, and outbound processes.
Own stock accuracy (aged and non-aged inventory) for commercial, free stock, and demo.
Conduct monthly inventory cycle count reconciliation, analyze the stock accuracy and provide the report including the comprehensive CAPA for any discrepancies.
Plan and lead stock takes and submit the reports to relevant stakeholders.
Manage 3rd party product purchase based on order requirements, collaborate with stakeholders to ensure product availability in the right quantity, at the right time, and with the right product.
Ensure implementation of Good Warehouse Practice in alignment with GDPMD requirements.
Lead shelf-life management for stocks with expiry dates to maintain inventory quality and compliance.
Participate in lean supply chain initiatives and continuous improvement programs to enhance operational efficiency.

Resilient person with 2–3 years of relevant experience in logistics, supply chain, or warehouse operations.
Strong vendor management skills (customs brokers, warehouse providers, last mile delivery partners).

Very good analytical and numerical skills.
Understanding of warehouse processes (inbound, put-away, pick & pack, outbound)
Strong organizational skills, including structured e-filing.
Ability to work independently with a proactive, customer-first mindset.
How we work at Philips
Our newly adopted hybrid work concept fuses flexibility with collaboration to deliver great outcomes for our people and our customers. We are embracing an approach wherein we spend more time together than apart – which for full-time employees translates to an average of at least 3 days working from the office and up to 2 days from home – for our hybrid roles.
Hybrid work flexibility means people can meet the changing demands of work and home in the most balanced, productive, and healthy way.

s.h: Our hybrid working model is defined in 3 ways
s.t:
We believe in the importance of impactful collaboration: There's a certain energy when everyone’s in the same room that can heighten idea generation and creative friction needed for problem-solving.
We embrace flexibility: Choosing where, when and how to work can vary according to task and team schedules. Flexibility isn’t office or online, it means choosing the space that works best for you, your teams and our customers on a case-by-case basis.
We want to be at our best: The way we work, and our workspaces are designed to support our well-being, offer career advancement opportunities, and enable us to be at our best.
Why should you join Philips?
Working at Philips is more than a job. It’s a calling to create a healthier society through meaningful work, focused on innovative, customer-first health technology solutions. Help us improve the health and well-being of billions of people, every year. Ultimately creating a career that no one could have planned for. Even you.
About Philips
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

The Export Logistics Specialist oversees and manages end-to-end export operations to ensure that goods leave the organization’s facilities and reach international vendors on time, within budget and in full compliance of all agreed regulations; including safety standards.
The role is focused on planning, coordination, documentation & stakeholder management for all exports handled by Soko.

Export Operations & Coordination
Plan, organize, and oversee the entire export process from order placement to delivery at the destination.
Coordinate with production, warehousing, and procurement teams to ensure accurate and timely order fulfillment.
Liaise with freight forwarders, carriers, and third-party logistics providers to schedule shipments.
Track shipments, resolve delays, and ensure smooth cargo movement.
Documentation & Compliance
Prepare and review all required export documentation (invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, export licenses, etc.).
Ensure compliance with international trade laws, customs regulations, and organizational policies.
Maintain accurate records of shipments for audit and reporting purposes.
Stay updated on changes in export/import regulations, customs procedures, and trade agreements.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary point of contact for clients regarding export logistics inquiries.
Provide timely updates to customers on order and shipment status.
Resolve customer complaints, shipment issues, or documentation errors promptly.
Build and maintain strong relationships with shipping agents, port authorities, and regulatory agencies.
Performance Management
Negotiate shipping rates and terms with carriers and freight forwarders to optimize costs.
Analyze export logistics performance and recommend process improvements for efficiency and cost savings.
Reconditioning
Support and coordinate container reconditioning logistics when overseas regulators identify non-compliance issues.
Ensure all reconditioning processes follow approved SOPs and documentation standards before goods are released to buyers.
Maintain close communication with third-party service providers managing sterilization or product rework.
Supply Chain Traceability
Ensure all exported goods have a clear, verifiable origin and traceable supply chain documentation.
Work with sourcing and quality teams to build systems that enable end-to-end traceability of export products.
Maintain audit-ready export documentation, certifications, and inspection records in compliance with global regulatory standards.
Cost efficiency
Monitor freight costs, customs duties, and tariffs to control budgets.
Identify opportunities for cost reduction across shipping, warehousing, and handling processes.
Implement strategies that improve container utilization, reduce demurrage/detention, and optimize route planning.
Regularly review freight spend and propose cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality or timelines.

## About Our Client ##
Maison familiale suisse basé à Genève, et reconnue pour son savoir-faire, son exigence de qualité et son attachement à l'innovation.
L'entreprise franchit une nouvelle étape dans l'évolution de ses opérations logistiques, avec la mise en place d'un environnement de stockage presque entièrement automatisé.
Nous recherchons un(e) **Responsable Logistique** pour accompagner cette évolution, assurer la bonne gestion des stocks et des flux internes, et développer les compétences d'une équipe d'environ 20 collaborateurs.
## Job Description ##
Management et développement de l'équipe
* Encadrer, animer et accompagner une équipe d'environ 20 collaborateurs évoluant dans un environnement de stockage.
* Identifier les compétences et les potentiels au sein de l'équipe, et favoriser leur développement vers des responsabilités élargies, notamment en gestion des stocks.
* Développer la polyvalence et la flexibilité des collaborateurs afin de renforcer la capacité d'adaptation de l'organisation.
* Instaurer un management de proximité, fondé sur la confiance, la communication et l'accompagnement des équipes.
Gestion des stocks et des flux internes
* Superviser la réception des matières premières ainsi que la gestion des stocks de matières premières, de produits semi-finis et de produits finis.
* Garantir la fiabilité des mouvements de stocks et la bonne circulation des produits entre les différents ateliers.
* Assurer la coordination des flux internes, depuis la réception des matières premières jusqu'à la mise à disposition des produits finis.
* Superviser les opérations de préparation et de picking lorsque les besoins spécifiques des clients le nécessitent.
* Coordonner les inventaires et contribuer à l'amélioration de la fiabilité des données de stock.
Analyse et amélioration continue
* Analyser les flux, les niveaux de stock et les indicateurs de performance afin d'identifier les axes d'amélioration.
* Proposer et mettre en œuvre des actions visant à optimiser l'organisation et l'efficacité des opérations logistiques.
* Exploiter les données disponibles dans SAP et Excel pour assurer un suivi rigoureux de l'activité et faciliter la prise de décision.
* Accompagner l'évolution des méthodes de travail dans le contexte du déménagement et de l'automatisation du nouvel entrepôt.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Planning, Achats & Approvisionnement, Production et Customer Service afin de garantir la cohérence des flux.
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Formation supérieure en logistique, Supply Chain ou domaine équivalent.
* Expérience confirmée en management d'équipes logistiques, idéalement dans un environnement de stockage et de gestion des stocks.
* Solide compréhension des enjeux liés aux stocks, aux flux internes et à la coordination avec la production.
* Capacité à identifier les compétences et les potentiels au sein d'une équipe, et à développer la polyvalence des collaborateurs.
* Bonnes capacités analytiques et aptitude à exploiter les données pour identifier des améliorations concrètes.
* Maîtrise de SAP et excellente maîtrise d'Excel.
* Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement opérationnel exigeant, à gérer les priorités et à faire face aux imprévus.
Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personnalité accessible, honnête et bienveillante, qui privilégie une approche pragmatique et collaborative du management.
Vous appréciez le terrain et le contact avec les équipes, tout en étant capable de prendre de la hauteur pour structurer, analyser et améliorer les opérations. Vous souhaitez vous inscrire dans un projet à long terme et contribuer durablement au développement de l'organisation.
La maîtrise de l'anglais n'est pas requise.
## What's on Offer ##
* L'opportunité de rejoindre une entreprise familiale suisse reconnue pour son savoir-faire et la qualité de ses produits.
* Un rôle clé dans une étape importante de transformation logistique, vers un nouvel environnement de stockage presque entièrement automatisé.
* La responsabilité d'une équipe d'environ 20 collaborateurs, avec un réel potentiel de développement des compétences et de la polyvalence.
* Un environnement de travail collaboratif, au sein d'un département Supply Chain structuré.
* Un contrat à durée indéterminée à 100%, basé à Genève.
* 28 jours de vacances, auxquels s'ajoutent les éventuelles compensations liées aux horaires de travail.
* Une organisation du temps de travail basée sur 41 heures hebdomadaires contractuelles, avec une compensation des heures supplémentaires selon les modalités en vigueur.
* Une possibilité ponctuelle de télétravail, selon les besoins du poste.
* Un parking sur site et une participation aux transports publics.

Coordinate with internal teams (Production, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Quality) to align shipping schedules with production needs and resolve material shortages or delivery issues in real time.
Execute sourcing and rate management activities for carriers and logistics providers, including obtaining quotes, negotiating spot rates, and managing ongoing performance with 3PLs and freight partners.
Analyze and improve outbound transportation methods, routing, and packaging to reduce cost, transit time, and damage while supporting high-mix, high-volume manufacturing requirements.
Develop and maintain operational dashboards and KPIs that provide visibility into shipping performance, carrier reliability, and fulfillment status for manufacturing and ground infrastructure programs.
Lead cost-reduction and process improvement initiatives focused on shipping operations, including mode optimization, packaging improvements, and freight consolidation.
Ensure compliance with all applicable shipping regulations, including customs, Incoterms, hazardous materials (as required), and export control requirements.
Act as the primary point of escalation for shipping and logistics issues, leading root-cause analysis and implementing corrective actions with carriers and internal stakeholders.
Document and standardize best practices for shipping processes, material handling, and packaging to improve consistency and efficiency across operations.
